oracle.input: Actual trusted browser beforeinput through the existing native CDP driver; standalone contenteditable is the reference.
oracle.equivalence: In collapsing CSS only, SPACE and NBSP are equivalent for logical-text comparison. Each requested space must independently occupy nonzero width. Exact formatting, caret and save/Undo/Redo snapshots remain asserted.
oracle.reason: Keeping the authored BR inside its formatting wrapper changes browser whitespace affinity. Two sequential spaces can become NBSP+NBSP while an unformatted native continuation uses NBSP+SPACE. Requiring the latter bytes would couple acceptance to the browser path that drops the active mark.
oracle.diagnostic: diagnostic-strict-serialization.log.gz preserves the intermediate overly strict byte-comparison attempt. It is not a final verification gate; the final fixture was rerun against both unchanged and repaired production source.
